You may not deploy to production at these times [1]:

- Fridays after 3pm IST
- During Deepavali week
- In the week around Makara Sankranti
- From 25 March to 5 April (the financial year end)
- Inside a client's declared freeze window

The only exception is an emergency fix for a P1, which needs the delivery lead's approval in writing [1]. Client freeze windows are recorded on the client record, so check it before you plan a release [1].

Outside those periods, changes are allowed, but they still need a peer review and a rollback plan before deployment [1].

## Production changes and freezes

No production changes are made on Fridays after 3pm IST, during Deepavali week, in the week around Makara Sankranti, from 25 March to 5 April (the financial year end), or inside a client's declared freeze window. The only exception is an emergency fix for a P1, which needs the delivery lead's approval in writing. All other changes need a peer review and a rollback plan before they are deployed. Client freeze windows are recorded on the client record, so check it before you plan a release.
